newsitem.title: UK: Strong sterling calls the tune in Bradford wool.
newsitem.headline: Strong sterling calls the tune in Bradford wool.

text.p: A strong pound sterling caused some further price reductions and also made imports from major wool firms in continental Europe more competitive.
UK exporters saw no relief as the strength of sterling made their sales more costly.
Those basing prices on imported wool have been able to limit the imact of the strong Australian market to some extent, but were worried about the future.

Deliveries are going out well. Firms say new business is difficult to obtain but one or two found a fair amount last week, perhaps in anticipation of renewed firmness in Australia. - - London Newsroom 44 171 542 7729
